actionable_steps.citation: Three In One — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 21 (1988), 1988-07-29
actionable_steps.step: Pray from the heart, not the lips — the Lord will accept a heart without words, but not words and prayers that do not come from the heart.

actionable_steps.citation: Right use of Time — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 30 (1997), 1997-04-07
actionable_steps.step: Change what you ask for: pray to God for the grace of His love and bliss, not for worldly desires.

actionable_steps.citation: Be Ever Grateful To God (Alternative Translation) — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 29 (1996), 1996-08-17
actionable_steps.step: Let gratitude itself be your prayer — expressing thanks awakens the inner Divinity within you.

actionable_steps.citation: The Crowning Virtue — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 21 (1988), 1988-01-07
actionable_steps.step: Pray with childlike innocence and a pure heart — drop the questions of where God is and how He will help.
Make your prayer unselfish, saturated with love, and free from attachment to the gift the prayer would bring.

definition.citation: Three In One — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 21 (1988), 1988-07-29
definition.quote: Prayer does not mean petitioning to God. Prayer is an index of the experience of Atmic bliss. … Prayer must come from the heart. Prayer that is not heartfelt is utterly useless.

discourses.citation: Be Ever Grateful To God (Alternative Translation) — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 29 (1996), 1996-08-17
discourses.quote: Expression of gratitude is itself prayer. What does prayer do? It awakens the inner Divinity of a person, which is immeasurable, invisible, and transcendental. … True prayer comes from the heart, not merely from lips.

discourses.citation: Right use of Time — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 30 (1997), 1997-04-07
discourses.quote: Many pray to God all over the world. They pray for the realisation of worldly desires of one kind or another. This is not the right kind of prayer. You should pray to God for the grace of His love. That love is everlasting. It is infinite.

discourses.citation: The new year dress — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 11 (1971 - 72), 1971-03-27
discourses.quote: When you pray to God for a job, or a son, or a prize, you are devoted, not to God, but to the job, to the son and to the prize. Pray to God for God.

discourses.citation: The Crowning Virtue — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 21 (1988), 1988-01-07
discourses.quote: The moral of the story is that if we pray to God with a pure heart, God will make use of someone to respond to our prayer. … "If you want to pray to God, be like an innocent child."

make_it_real: Tonight, skip the shopping list — just thank Him for one thing, and ask for one thing that money can't buy.
title: Prayer

vahinis.quote: Three types of activity reach God and earn His grace: (1) Activity not prompted by personal desire, (2) Activity emanating from unselfish love, and (3) Prayer arising from pure hearts. … Therefore, prayers have to be unselfish, saturated with love, and free from the taint of attachment to the gift that the prayer would bring.
